summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No: 835/MP/2025** ## **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member** ## **Date of Order: 18[th] February, 2026** ## **In the matter of:** Petition under Section 79(1)(C) & 79(1)(K) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 65 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 11 & 12 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Deviation settlement mechanism and related matters) Regulations, 2024, Regulation 41 & 42 of the GNA Regulations, 2022 and any other relevant laws seeking inter alia the approval of the metering scheme proposed by the Petitioner in relation to the BESS Project being setup pursuant to Regulation 5.2 of the GNA Regulations, 2022 to optimize the usage of already granted connectivity quantum of 1200 MW to the Petitioner / its SPVs. ## **And in the matter of:** ## **ACME Solar Holdings Limited** Plot No. 152, Sector 44, Gurgaon-122002, Haryana **...Petitioner** ## **Vs.** ## **1. Central Transmission Utility of India Limited,** Floors No. 5-10, Tower 1, Plot No. 16, IRCON, International Tower, Institutional Area, Sector 32, Gurugram– 122001, Haryana ## **2. Northern Regional Load Despatch Centre,** B9, 1[st] Floor, Qutab Institutional Area, Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi -110016 ## **3. Grid Controller of India Limited,** B-9, 1[st] and 2[nd ] Floor, Qutab Institutional Area, Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi -110016 ## **4. Northern Regional Power Committee** 18-A, Qutab Institutional Area, Shaheed Jeet Singh Marg, Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi. Order in Petition No. 835/MP/2025 **1** ## ** Respondents** ## **Parties Present:** Shri Aniket Prasoon, Advocate, ASHL Shri Vinit Kumar, Advocate, ASHL Shri Sarthak Sareen, Advocate, ASHL Ms. Kavya Bhardwaj, CTUIL Shri Kamaldeep, NRLDC Shri Ajit Kumar Yadav, NRLDC Shri Alok Mishra, NRLDC Shri Rahul Negi, NRLDC Ms. Himani Dutta, NRLDC ## **ORDER** The present Petition has been filed by the Petitioner, ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ASHL) seeking the following relief(s): - _“a. Admit the present Petition;_ _b. Hold and declare that the metering scheme proposed by the Petitioner in furtherance of the installation of BESS is in compliance of the applicable regulations / law;_ _c. Consequentially, issue a direction to NRLDC to allow the Petitioner to inject, draw and schedule power into and from the grid from the respective solar power project(s) and respective BESS power project(s) in accordance with the metering scheme suggested by the Petitioner, with or / without modification(s) as may be considered appropriate while ensuring that the core objective of the Petitioner gets fulfilled / achieved._ _d. Direct CTUIL to take all necessary steps to ensure that no impediment is caused to the Petitioners’ lawful operation of the BESS to be installed by REGS as part of its already granted / existing connectivity under Regulation 5.2 of the GNA Regulations, 2022, including by way of drawing power from the ISTS / grid for charging of such BESS power project(s), so far the net injection / drawal remains within the quantum of the already granted connectivity in term of the applicable regulations;_ _e. Direct Grid Controller of India to include the scenario of charging of storage from the excess power generated beyond connectivity quantum by RE project, in its procedure for metering, accounting and deviation settlement, Transmission charge waiver and REC mechanism related to ESS whose draft consultation was issued by Grid Controller of India on 06.08.2025._ _f. In the alternative to the aforesaid prayers and in light of the submission made above this Hon’ble Commission may be pleased to exercise its power to relax to allow utilising the excess instantaneous power generated beyond connectivity quantum from existing solar projects for the purpose of charging of storage/BESS._ Order in Petition No. 835/MP/2025 **2** _g. Pass any other or further order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and interest of justice”._ 2. The matter was admitted on 1.10.2025, and the notice was issued to the Respondents permitting them to file their replies, if any. On 7.11.2025, the Respondent, Northern Regional Load Despatch Centre (NRLDC), filed its reply and submitted that the “ _Procedure for Scheduling, Metering, Accounting and Deviation Settlement, Transmission Charge Waiver and REC Mechanism related to ESS”_ has been issued by NLDC/Grid-India on 6.10.2025. The matter was, thereafter, listed for hearing on 9.12.2025 and 5.2.2026. During the hearing on 5.2.2026, the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present Petition with liberty to approach the Commission, if required, in accordance with law and to file an appropriate affidavit to this effect. Considering the same, the Commission permitted the Petitioner to file its affidavit. 3. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 14.2.2026, has submitted that the main prayer of the Petitioner relating to approval of the metering scheme has substantially fructified as the Respondent, NRDLC, has approved the final metering scheme on 6.10.2025. As per the Petitioner, in terms of such developments in the matter, the Petitioner may be permitted to withdraw the Petition, with liberty to approach the Commission, in accordance with law, in the event any regulatory, operational, scheduling, deviation settlement or integration-related issues arise at the stage of implementation of BESS integration with the co-located solar projects. 4. The Respondent, NRLDC, _vide_ its written submissions dated 12.2.2026, has clarified that the metering scheme applicable to the Petitioner was already communicated to the Petitioner on 23.6.2025. The _Procedure for Scheduling, Metering,_ Order in Petition No. 835/MP/2025 **3** _Accounting and Deviation Settlement, Transmission Charge Waiver and REC Mechanism related to ESS_ issued by NLDC/Grid-India on 6.10.2025, after having stakeholders’ consultations, is a general procedural framework and not any revised project-specific metering scheme in respect of the Petitioner. 5. Considering the submissions of the Petitioner made in the affidavit dated 14.2.2026, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition with the liberty to approach the Commission in accordance with the law. It is also taken on record that on 6.10.2025, NLDC/Grid-India has issued the general procedural framework, viz. _Procedure for Scheduling, Metering, Accounting and Deviation Settlement, Transmission Charge Waiver and REC Mechanism related to ESS_ . 6. Accordingly, Petition No. 835/MP/2025 is disposed of, as withdrawn. **Sd/Sd/Sd/(Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 835/MP/2025 **4** CERC Website S. No. 117/2026
